author: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum
longDescription: Frank Baum is a novel published in 1901. When young electrical experimenter Rob accidentally touches the Master Key of Electricity, he summons the Daemon of Electricity, who grants him nine futuristic gifts over three weeks—including flying devices, food tablets, and protective garments.

authorInfo.bio:
L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum (1856–1919) is the author of The Master Key
An Electrical Fairy Tale Founded Upon the Mysteries of Electricity. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
